presets.name: Plain
presets.description: Bold white sans-serif with no decoration; the default.

presets.name: Caption
presets.description: Smaller bold white text on a translucent black box; subtitles and lower thirds.

presets.name: Outline
presets.description: Yellow Impact letters with a thick black outline; meme or punchy look.

presets.name: Neon
presets.description: White rounded letters with a pink neon glow and a gentle pulse.

presets.name: Pop title
presets.description: Large white Impact title with a hard drop shadow that pops in and shrinks out.

presets.name: Typewriter
presets.description: Light grey monospace that types itself on.

presets.name: Glow
presets.description: Italic white serif with a cyan glow that floats softly.

presets.name: Echo
presets.description: White Impact letters with pink echo copies that slide up in.

presets.name: Soft shadow
presets.description: Bold white sans-serif with a soft drop shadow; stays readable on bright pictures without a box.

presets.name: Cinematic
presets.description: Warm off-white serif, widely letter-spaced, with a soft shadow; film titles and chapter cards.

presets.name: Sci-fi caption
presets.description: Bottom-right location/date stamp ("Seattle / Year 2027"): cyan-white Share Tech Mono with a soft glow, decoded from scrambling digits.

presets.name: Glow
presets.description: Soft coloured glow around the letters.

params.label: Blur
params.description: Glow radius as a fraction of the font size.

presets.name: Neon
presets.description: Bright neon tube look with a strong coloured glow.

params.label: Blur
params.description: Glow radius as a fraction of the font size.

presets.name: Hollow
presets.description: Outline-only letters with a transparent fill.

presets.name: Echo
presets.description: Repeated offset copies behind the text.

params.label: Offset
params.description: Offset between the copies, as a fraction of the font size.

presets.name: Fade
presets.description: Fades the text in from transparent.

presets.name: Slide up
presets.description: Fades in while sliding up into place from slightly below.

params.label: Distance
params.description: How far the text travels, as a fraction of the frame size (0.1 = 10%).

params.label: X
params.description: Side the text is offset to while hidden (it slides from / to there): -1 left, 1 right, 0 none.

params.label: Y
params.description: Side the text is offset to while hidden: -1 above, 1 below, 0 none.

presets.name: Slide left
presets.description: Fades in while sliding left into place from the right.

params.label: Distance
params.description: How far the text travels, as a fraction of the frame size (0.1 = 10%).

params.label: X
params.description: Side the text is offset to while hidden (it slides from / to there): -1 left, 1 right, 0 none.

params.label: Y
params.description: Side the text is offset to while hidden: -1 above, 1 below, 0 none.

presets.name: Pop
presets.description: Scales up from small with a springy overshoot; lively titles and labels.

params.label: Overshoot
params.description: Extra size at the middle of the pop, as a fraction of full size (0.12 = 12% larger).

presets.name: Zoom
presets.description: Grows from nothing to full size.

presets.name: Typewriter
presets.description: Reveals the text one character at a time, with an optional cursor (one character = blinking cursor, several = scramble/decode).

params.label: Cursor
params.description: Cursor characters. Empty = no cursor; one character (| or _) = a cursor after the text; several (0123456789) = each new character shows random ones of these before it resolves (decode effect).

params.label: Blink rate
params.description: Cursor blinks per second once typing has finished (0 = solid).

params.label: After typing
params.description: What the cursor does when typing is done: blink = keep blinking, hide = disappear at once, fade = fade out over 0.5 s.

params.label: Scramble time
params.description: Seconds each character cycles through the cursor characters before resolving (only with several cursor characters).

presets.name: Wipe
presets.description: Reveals the text left to right behind a moving edge.

presets.name: Blur
presets.description: Fades in from a soft blur to sharp; gentle, cinematic.

params.label: Blur
params.description: Blur radius in pixels at the hidden end.

presets.name: Fade
presets.description: Fades the text out to transparent.

presets.name: Slide down
presets.description: Fades out while sliding down.

params.label: Distance
params.description: How far the text travels, as a fraction of the frame size (0.1 = 10%).

params.label: X
params.description: Side the text is offset to while hidden (it slides from / to there): -1 left, 1 right, 0 none.

params.label: Y
params.description: Side the text is offset to while hidden: -1 above, 1 below, 0 none.

presets.name: Shrink
presets.description: Shrinks to nothing.

presets.name: Blur
presets.description: Blurs and fades away.

params.label: Blur
params.description: Blur radius in pixels at the hidden end.

presets.name: Wipe
presets.description: Hides the text right to left behind a moving edge.

presets.name: Pulse
presets.description: Gently grows and shrinks in a loop.

params.label: Period
params.description: Length of one cycle in seconds.

params.label: Amount
params.description: Size change at the peak, as a fraction of full size (0.06 = 6%).

presets.name: Wiggle
presets.description: Rocks side to side in a loop; playful.

params.label: Period
params.description: Length of one cycle in seconds.

params.label: Degrees
params.description: Largest rotation each way, in degrees.

presets.name: Float
presets.description: Bobs softly up and down in a loop.

params.label: Period
params.description: Length of one cycle in seconds.

params.label: Amount
params.description: Largest vertical offset, as a fraction of the frame height.

presets.name: Blink
presets.description: Blinks on and off in a loop.

params.label: Period
params.description: Length of one cycle in seconds.

presets.name: Fade in
presets.description: Fades the picture in from black at the start of the range.

params.label: Length
params.description: fraction of the effect's time range, not seconds; 0.5 fades in over the first half of the range

presets.name: Fade out
presets.description: Fades the picture out to black at the end of the range.

params.label: Length
params.description: fraction of the effect's time range, not seconds; 0.5 fades out over the last half of the range

presets.name: Blur
presets.description: Blurs the whole picture.

params.label: Amount
params.description: Blur strength 0-1; 1 = a blur radius of 2% of the frame height.

presets.name: Zoom
presets.description: Slow zoom and pan across the picture (push-in); brings stills to life.

params.label: Zoom
params.description: Extra zoom reached at the end of the range, as a fraction of full size (0.25 = 25% larger).

params.label: Pan
params.description: Horizontal drift reached at the end of the range, as a fraction of the frame width (negative = left).

presets.name: Shake
presets.description: Handheld camera shake.

params.label: Amount
params.description: Largest offset, as a fraction of the frame size.

params.label: Speed
params.description: Shake oscillations over the whole effect range (a count, not per second).

presets.name: Vignette
presets.description: Darkens the frame edges to focus the centre.

params.label: Amount
params.description: Edge darkness, 0 (none) to 1 (black corners).

presets.name: B&W
presets.description: Black-and-white (desaturated) picture.

params.label: Amount
params.description: Desaturation, 0 (full colour) to 1 (black and white).

presets.name: Glow
presets.description: Soft bloom: bright areas bleed a gentle halo of light; dreamy, warm or magical scenes.

params.label: Strength
params.description: Opacity of the added light, 0 (off) to 1 (full).

params.label: Radius
params.description: Halo size as a fraction of the frame height.

params.label: Threshold
params.description: Which areas glow, 0 (the whole picture, soft haze) to 1 (only the brightest highlights).

params.label: Tint
params.description: Colour of the light (#rrggbb); white keeps the picture's own colours.

ai.use: dream sequences, memories, candle or sunset light, magic moments
ai.avoid: dark scenes with no highlights (little visible effect)

presets.name: Normal
presets.description: Covers the layers under it (default).

presets.name: Screen
presets.description: Black disappears and light areas brighten what is under it. Use for light leaks, flares, sparks, dust or glow footage shot on black.

presets.name: Add
presets.description: Adds its brightness to what is under it (linear dodge); black disappears, bright areas burn to white. Stronger than screen: use for fire, sparks and lens flares.

presets.name: Lighten
presets.description: Keeps whichever pixel is lighter, the clip or what is under it. Use to drop a dark background off light graphics.

presets.name: Multiply
presets.description: White disappears and dark areas darken what is under it. Use for paper, ink, scribbles, shadows or vignettes on white.

presets.name: Darken
presets.description: Keeps whichever pixel is darker, the clip or what is under it. Use to drop a white background off dark graphics.

presets.name: Overlay
presets.description: Adds contrast: mid grey disappears, lighter areas brighten and darker areas darken what is under it. Use for film grain, textures and colour washes on grey.

presets.name: Soft light
presets.description: A gentler overlay: mid grey disappears and the picture under it is lightly brightened or darkened. Use for subtle grain, haze or colour tints.

presets.name: PA announcement
presets.description: Public-address loudspeaker in a large space: thin horn tone, slap-back echo and a long tail. Use for station, airport, stadium or school announcements.

ai.use: an announcement over loudspeakers in a big public space
ai.avoid: normal narration or dialogue in a small room

presets.name: Hall
presets.description: Large hall reverb with a long smooth tail. Use for a church, cathedral, cave, empty warehouse or a dreamy, epic voice.

ai.use: a voice or sound in a very large space, or a dream/flashback feel

presets.name: Room
presets.description: Small room reverb: a short natural reflection that places a dry recording in an indoor space (office, bedroom, bathroom).

ai.use: a dry voiceover or sound effect should sound like it happens in the room on screen

presets.name: Telephone
presets.description: Voice heard through a phone: narrow 300–3400 Hz band with slight distortion. Use for the other side of a phone call or a voicemail.

ai.use: a character speaking on the phone or a voicemail

presets.name: Radio
presets.description: Old AM radio or walkie-talkie: band-limited, crunchy and nasal. Use for broadcasts, police/army radio chatter or a vintage feel.

ai.use: a radio broadcast, intercom, walkie-talkie or vintage recording

presets.name: Muffled / underwater
presets.description: Muffled sound with the highs removed: underwater, behind a wall or door, from the next room, or a character losing consciousness.

ai.use: sound heard underwater, through a wall or door, or a dazed point of view

presets.name: Robot
presets.description: Metallic robot or AI voice: ring modulation and a short resonant comb echo. Use for robots, androids, computer voices and aliens.

ai.use: a robot, android, computer or alien voice

presets.name: Crossfade
presets.description: The outgoing clip dissolves into the incoming clip.

presets.name: Dip to black
presets.description: Fades the outgoing clip to black, then up into the incoming clip.

presets.name: Dip to white
presets.description: Fades the outgoing clip to white, then out of white into the incoming clip; dreamy or memory scenes.

params.label: Colour
params.description: Colour the picture dips through (#rrggbb).

presets.name: Flash
presets.description: A quick bright flash hides the cut; punchy, for beats and reveals.

params.label: Colour
params.description: Flash colour (#rrggbb).

params.label: Strength
params.description: Opacity of the flash at its peak, 0 (none) to 1 (full).

presets.name: Light leak
presets.description: A warm film light leak flares across the frame and hides the cut; nostalgic, dreamy, memories.

params.label: Colour
params.description: Colour of the leak (#rrggbb).

params.label: Strength
params.description: Brightness of the leak at its peak, 0 (none) to 1 (full).

params.label: Direction
params.description: Sweep direction: 1 left to right, -1 right to left.

ai.use: memories, travel and lifestyle montages, warm golden-hour edits
ai.avoid: fast action cuts or cold, clinical looks

params.label: Motion blur

presets.name: Circle open
presets.description: The incoming clip opens from a growing circle in the centre.

presets.name: Zoom in
presets.description: Rushes forward: the outgoing clip zooms in and the incoming clip continues the push; energetic.

params.label: Out zoom
params.description: Scale the outgoing clip reaches, as a multiplier of full size (1 = unchanged).

params.label: In zoom
params.description: Scale the incoming clip starts from, as a multiplier of full size (1 = unchanged).

params.label: Blur
params.description: Peak blur as a fraction of the frame height.

presets.name: Zoom out
presets.description: Pulls back: the outgoing clip shrinks away and the incoming clip settles in from larger.

params.label: Out zoom
params.description: Scale the outgoing clip reaches, as a multiplier of full size (1 = unchanged).

params.label: In zoom
params.description: Scale the incoming clip starts from, as a multiplier of full size (1 = unchanged).

params.label: Blur
params.description: Peak blur as a fraction of the frame height.

presets.name: Spin
presets.description: The outgoing clip spins away and the incoming clip spins into place; playful.

params.label: Turn
params.description: Degrees each clip turns.

presets.name: Blur dissolve
presets.description: Both clips soften into a blur while they cross-dissolve; smooth and gentle.

params.label: Blur
params.description: Peak blur as a fraction of the frame height.

presets.name: Defocus
presets.description: The outgoing clip goes out of focus, then the incoming clip pulls into focus.

params.label: Blur
params.description: Peak blur as a fraction of the frame height.

params.label: Hard cut
params.description: Switch mode: 1 (on) swaps the clips at full blur, 0 (off) dissolves them.

presets.name: Glitch
presets.description: Digital glitch: picture bands jump sideways around a hard cut; tech, horror, hype.

params.label: Amount
params.description: Largest band shift as a fraction of the frame width.

presets.name: Shake
presets.description: A camera jolt around a hard cut; impacts and beat drops.

params.label: Amount
params.description: Largest jolt as a fraction of the frame.

synth.label: Attack

synth.label: Release

synth.label: Tone

whoosh.label: Peak at

wind.label: Gusts
wind.description: How much the level and band move.
